name: residential_init_after_load
description: Test 21 and section 9.3. A record whose education block has the strike flag set (start 1000), whose health max funding is 5.0, with leSum 77 and an iterator of step 3 advanced once, is read into a constructed simulator: the flag is still 1 after Read. Init is not 'initialised', so step 7 re-reads the simulator tuning into both blocks: the strike flag and start become 0 and max funding the shipped 120 x 0.01f (0x3F999999). Step 10 resets the iterator to fresh at (0, 0) keeping step 3, and leSum to 0. Read set 'city started', so step 6 does not take the loading city's developer tract size (2): P = E stay the saved 4. The loaded departments (900-903) are kept and none is created.
